translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: dashed magenta paths are balls sliding, solid cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: انقر على العدسة لترى الفيزياء: المسارات المتقطعة بلون الماجنتا للكرات المنزلقة، والمسارات المتصلة السماوية للكرات المتدحرجة، والأسمك أسرع. اسحب الشريط للتنقل في الضربة في الاتجاهين.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: dashed magenta paths are balls sliding, solid cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Tippe auf Lens, um die Physik zu sehen: Gestrichelte magentafarbene Linien zeigen gleitende Kugeln, durchgezogene türkisfarbene Linien rollende Kugeln, dickere Linien sind schneller. Ziehe die Leiste, um den Stoß in beide Richtungen durchzugehen.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: dashed magenta paths are balls sliding, solid cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Toca Lente para ver la física: las trayectorias magenta discontinuas son bolas deslizándose, las cian continuas son bolas rodando; cuanto más gruesa, más rápida. Arrastra la barra para recorrer el tiro en cualquiera de los dos sentidos.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: dashed magenta paths are balls sliding, solid cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Touche Lentille pour voir la physique : les trajectoires magenta en pointillés sont des billes qui glissent, les trajectoires cyan pleines des billes qui roulent ; plus c'est épais, plus c'est rapide. Fais glisser la barre pour parcourir le coup dans les deux sens.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: dashed magenta paths are balls sliding, solid cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
translations.text: Tocca Lens per vedere la fisica: le linee magenta tratteggiate indicano palle che scivolano, quelle turchesi continue palle che rotolano, quelle più spesse sono più veloci. Trascina la barra per scorrere il tiro in entrambe le direzioni.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: dashed magenta paths are balls sliding, solid cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: dashed magenta paths are balls sliding, solid cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: dashed magenta paths are balls sliding, solid cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.

translations.key: Tap Lens to see the physics: dashed magenta paths are balls sliding, solid cyan paths are balls rolling, thicker is faster. Drag the bar to scrub through the shot either way.
